subject: Multiple shiny apps, issue with rendering subpages

messages.author: 46a914c6a00d1427
messages.subject: Multiple shiny apps, issue with rendering subpages
parts:
Hey guys,

I am new to Shiny, and I am totally impressed with it.

I played a bit with it, but I found a small issue I am unable to solve (I am novice to programming in general).

I want to have several small shiny apps running on different ports, and I want to combine them on a webpage with bootstrap template and couple of pages that will link apps via <iframe>. However, I am obviously missing some key elements.

Here is my ui.R:

library(shiny)
shinyUI(bootstrapPage(
  includeHTML('../html/www/index.html') 
))
index.html is just Bootstrap template with <iframe> pointing to localhost and different port for application.

And it works well on main page:
http://postimage.org/image/4djwpp6cf/

However, when I go to some other page on it, it doesn't render CSS (it seems to me?):
http://postimage.org/image/k31xm6vsh/

I am missing some binding part of some sort, but I am new to all this and if someone faced similar issue, if they could point me in right direction or offer some ways to solve the issue in more efficient manner, I would really appreciate it.
